title.zh: 将南哥打巴托省 Banga 市镇 San Jose 描笼涯的 Banga 国立中学附属校分离，改设为独立的 San Jose 国立中学，并为此拨款
title.en: An Act Separating the Banga National High School - San Jose Annex in Barangay San Jose, Municipality of Banga, Province of South Cotabato from the Banga National High School, Converting it into an Independent National High School to Be Known as San Jose National High School and Appropriatng Funds Therefor
title.orig: An Act Separating the Banga National High School - San Jose Annex in Barangay San Jose, Municipality of Banga, Province of South Cotabato from the Banga National High School, Converting it into an Independent National High School to Be Known as San Jose National High School and Appropriatng Funds Therefor
title.vi: Đạo luật tách Phân hiệu San Jose của Trường Trung học Banga Quốc gia tại Barangay San Jose, Đô thị Banga, Tỉnh South Cotabato khỏi Trường Trung học Banga Quốc gia và chuyển thành Trường Trung học Độc lập Quốc gia
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติแยกวิทยาเขต San Jose ของโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษา Banga แห่งชาติในบารังไกย์ San Jose เทศบาล Banga จังหวัด South Cotabato ออกจากโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษา Banga แห่งชาติและยกฐานะเป็นโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษาเอกเทศแห่งชาติ
title.id: Undang-Undang Memisahkan Kampus San Jose, Sekolah Menengah Banga Nasional di Barangay San Jose, Kotamadya Banga, Provinsi South Cotabato dari Sekolah Menengah Banga Nasional dan menjadi Sekolah Menengah Mandiri Nasional
title.ms: Akta Memisahkan Kampus San Jose, Sekolah Menengah Banga Kebangsaan di Barangay San Jose, Perbandaran Banga, Wilayah South Cotabato daripada Sekolah Menengah Banga Kebangsaan dan menjadi Sekolah Menengah Bebas Kebangsaan

text.en: Separation and Conversion into a National High School. - The Banga National High School - San Jose Annex in Barangay San Jose, Municipality of Banga, Province of South Cotabato is hereby separated from the Banga National High School and converted into an independent national high school to be known as San Jose National High School.

Transfer of Assets and Liabilities. - All personnel, assets, liabilities and records of the Banga National High School - San Jose Annex are hereby transferred to and absorbed by the San Jose National High School.

Appropriations. - The Secretary of Education shall immediately include in the Department's program the operationalization of the San Jose National High School, the initial funding of which shall be charged against the current year's appropriations of the Banga National High School - San Jose Annex. Thereafter, the amount necessary for the continued operation of the school shall be included in the annual General Appropriations Act.
Implementation. - The Secretary of Education shall issue rules and regulations that may be necessary to carry out the purpose of this Act.
Effectivity. - This Act shall take effect fifteen (15) days after its publication in the Official Gazette.
